name: chat-board-games
author: Takaro
description: Player vs player board games in chat: tic-tac-toe, connect-four and rock-paper-scissors. Challenge an online player, they accept or decline, the board is printed one chat line per row. Optional currency bet: both stakes are held until the end, the winner takes the pot, draws, declines and expired challenges are refunded. Turn reminders, turn timeouts, forfeit, stats and a leaderboard. Works on every game.

rpsBestOf.title: Rock-paper-scissors: best of
rpsBestOf.description: Rounds in a rock-paper-scissors match (1, 3 or 5). Same picks are replayed.

minBet.title: Minimum bet
minBet.description: Smallest bet when a player bets. Playing without a bet is always allowed.

maxBet.title: Maximum bet
maxBet.description: Largest bet per player. 0 = bets off (friendly games only).

houseFeePercent.title: House fee (%)
houseFeePercent.description: Percent of the pot kept by the server when someone wins. 0 = winner takes all. Draws are always refunded in full.

challengeTimeoutMinutes.title: Challenge timeout (minutes)
challengeTimeoutMinutes.description: Open challenges expire after this many minutes and the bet is refunded. Checked once a minute.

turnTimeoutMinutes.title: Turn timeout (minutes)
turnTimeoutMinutes.description: A player who does not move for this many minutes runs out of time. Checked once a minute.

turnTimeoutAction.title: On turn timeout
turnTimeoutAction.description: forfeit = the slow player loses and the other wins the pot. refund = the game is cancelled and both stakes are refunded.

reminderMinutes.title: Turn reminder (minutes)
reminderMinutes.description: Remind the player whose turn it is after this many idle minutes (once per turn). 0 = no reminders.

announceResults.title: Announce results
announceResults.description: Broadcast a one-line result to the whole server when a game ends.

permissions.description: Allows listing running board games and cancelling one (all stakes refunded).

challenge.description: Challenge an online player to tic-tac-toe, connect-four or rock-paper-scissors, with an optional currency bet.
challenge.helpText: challenge <player> <ttt|c4|rps> [bet] - the bet is taken now and held until the game ends.

arguments.name: player
arguments.helpText: Player name (full chat line is read, spaces allowed).

accept.description: Accept the board game challenge aimed at you. Your bet is held until the game ends.

decline.description: Decline the board game challenge aimed at you. The challenger gets their bet back.

move.description: Make your move: a square 1-9 (tic-tac-toe), a column 1-7 (connect-four) or rock/paper/scissors.

board.description: Show your current game, board and whose turn it is.

forfeit.description: Give up your running game (the other player wins the pot) or withdraw your open challenge (refunded).

gamestats.description: Show your board game wins, losses, draws and bet result, or another player's.

gametop.description: Board game leaderboard by wins, for all games or one game.

boardgames.description: How to play. Admins: boardgames list and boardgames cancel <player> (refunds all stakes).
boardgames.helpText: boardgames = help. boardgames list / boardgames cancel <player> need BOARD_GAMES_MANAGE.

arguments.name: action
arguments.helpText: Empty for help, list or cancel.

cbg-tick.description: Expires old challenges (refund), sends turn reminders and ends games where a player ran out of time.
